email.subject: Re: Zephyr unlock claim, from today
email.body:
You said today in your sprint retro: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock." It puts a number and a cause side by side, and names the integration as what made the widget shippable at that velocity.

The Zephyr integration is now recorded as the key unlock, under the decision-capture-at-consensus idea, the core claim that a decision should be captured at the moment it is made. The Sprint 4 retro's line that the widget "proved the thesis" is still standing beside it, so the two have to be read together.

That suggests to me the velocity is partly a tooling result, not only a team one, and that the Zephyr work has to keep running for the 23 points to repeat. I read that as the integration moving from a dependency to a deliverable. If that holds, the Sprint 4 proof rests more on Zephyr than on the widget alone, and that is worth checking before anyone repeats the claim in a planning doc.

Two things this leaves open, both answerable from your own work: Does the 23-point figure still hold if you take the Zephyr work out of the sprint? And does the Sprint 4 proof hold once the unlock is credited to Zephyr rather than the widget?
